subject.title: feat(discord): add event-edit and event-delete actions

question: Should Discord scheduled-event edit/delete ship under the existing events gate, or require separate destructive-event control before this PR can merge?
rationale: The choice changes the authorization boundary for existing deployments that already enabled Discord events for list/create, and automation should not decide whether destructive cancellation is covered by that old gate.

options.title: Require Separate Event Mutation Control
options.body: Add or choose a dedicated edit/delete or mutation gate while preserving the current list/create behavior for existing events-enabled deployments.

options.title: Accept Full Lifecycle Under Events
options.body: Explicitly document and test that enabling Discord events grants list, create, edit, and delete scheduled-event capability.

options.title: Pause For Broader Gate Design
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader granular Discord action-gate issue chooses the permanent least-privilege config shape.

recommendation.title: Require Separate Event Mutation Control
recommendation.body: Add or choose a dedicated edit/delete or mutation gate while preserving the current list/create behavior for existing events-enabled deployments.

likelyOwner.reason: The current auth hardening and prior review context make steipete the best available owner for the Discord security-boundary choice.
